title: Next-Gen orientation: supporting international students with generative AI NPCs in VR
claim_use: Strong VR/NPC bridge evidence; supports L5 bridge slice and observed spatial guidance usability, not general social emergence.
source_basis: Frontiers full text reports TUMSphere, Unreal Engine 5 + Convai generative NPCs, N=24 mixed-methods evaluation, knowledge bank, object/location awareness, NavMesh navigation, NPC escort behavior, and 100% navigation task completion.
coding_note: Code as L5 with caveat: spatial agency is implemented through engine/NavMesh/object position references; LLM dialogue uses knowledge/context rather than explicit Space Syntax metrics.
